stages.name: CONFIRM
stages.exit_when: every row is re-read at the capability head and marked CONFIRMED, or UNREPRODUCIBLE with tree_sha and attempt_log_ref

stages.name: EXPLOIT_SPEC
stages.exit_when: an executable repro-spec exists for the cluster and fails on base

stages.name: ACCEPTANCE_RED
stages.exit_when: every row has an acceptance ref that fails on base with fail_kind ASSERTION

stages.name: BUILD_AUDIT_RELEASE
stages.exit_when: release.merged_tree equals verdict.tree and Q-GUARD passes: the guard_ref node is present at verdict.head, is not skipped or xfailed, and passes in the verdict SUITE result

stages.name: PERMANENT_GUARD
stages.exit_when: post-merge permanence verification: the guard_ref node remains in the merged_tree (post-merge head), is not skipped or xfailed, and passes; its removal or skip reopens R1

unreproducible.reopen_when: the cited locus changes at a later tree

clustering.split_rule: split by locus prefix, never by row

register_edit_policy: the orchestrator never edits the register; drain-record is the audit trail
